lifecycles._note: Light monitoring lifecycle. Covers all 4 uncovered writes: puteventpolicy(POST /v1/cloudmonitorings/event/v2/event-policies), modifyeventpolicy(PUT .../{eventPolicyId}), deleteeventpolicy(DELETE .../{eventPolicyId}), getmetricperfdatalist(POST /v1/cloudmonitorings/product/v2/metric-data). NOTE the API name 'puteventpolicy'/'getmetricperfdatalist' are misleading: puteventpolicy is the CREATE (POST), getmetricperfdatalist is a read-shaped POST query. No data/api_bodies.json entry and docs are JS-rendered, so the event-policy body (product type, event conditions, notification addressbook) and the metric-data query body are BEST-GUESS and UNPROVEN — promote after a real 2xx. event-policy create likely requires a real productResourceId + addrbook member, so a 400/422 is expected; every mutating step is optional+grouped with a broad expect_status so it RECORDS coverage without failing. Capture path $.eventPolicyId is a guess (camelCase to mirror the path param); if absent the id-bound steps still normalize to the catalog '*' key. DELETE is destructive (gated).

steps.name: list-event-policies
steps._note: getproducteventpolicylist (pre-lifecycle read). Requires X-ResourceType header + productResourceId (live-confirmed: 200). Uses hardcoded 'apitest-logsink' (Object Storage resource in test account) as fallback so this step 200s even without a prior soft-capture. Dual-recorded under catalog key because it has params.

steps.name: create-event-policy
steps._note: puteventpolicy (CREATE). Body CONFIRMED via cascade probing 2026-06-24: must wrap in 'eventPolicyRequest' key. Required fields confirmed: eventPolicyName, productTypeCode, productResourceId, metricKey, eventLevel, disableYn, isLogMetric (string 'N' not boolean), eventThreshold, ftCount. isLogMetric must be string 'N'/'Y' not boolean (confirmed 2026-06-24: boolean false -> 400 'isLogMetric' error; string 'N' passes field validation). Currently returns 400 InvalidRequest null params because account products have state NE (not enrolled in monitoring backend). Blocker: account-prereq. On 4xx the group isolates; the POST is still recorded under its catalog key.

steps.name: modify-event-policy
steps._note: modifyeventpolicy (PUT). Body uses same confirmed shape as create-event-policy (eventPolicyRequest wrapper, isLogMetric as string 'N'). Only runs if create-event-policy succeeds and captures eventPolicyId. Account-prereq blocker applies.

steps.name: delete-event-policy
steps._note: If create captured no id (and the soft list capture also found none), {eventPolicyId} stays literal and the DELETE normalizes to the catalog '*' key (records coverage) and 404s harmlessly.

steps.name: probe-modify-event-policy
steps._note: modifyeventpolicy coverage probe. Uses {eventPolicyId} placeholder (maps to '*' via _norm_path, resolving to catalog key management/cloudmonitoring/modifyeventpolicy). Runs in its own group (cm-probe-modify) so it is never skipped by cm-policy group failure. If ctx has a real eventPolicyId (from create), sends a real PUT request. If not, sends literal {eventPolicyId} in path -> 400 InvalidInputValue (endpoint still reached and recorded under catalog key). CONFIRMED 2026-06-24: PUT /event-policies/999 -> 400 InvalidRequest (NE-state product), DELETE /event-policies/999 -> 404 (no such policy). Body uses confirmed shape (isLogMetric as string 'N', confirmed 2026-06-24).

steps.name: probe-delete-event-policy
steps._note: deleteeventpolicy coverage probe. Uses {eventPolicyId} placeholder (maps to '*' via _norm_path, resolving to catalog key management/cloudmonitoring/deleteeventpolicy). Runs in its own group (cm-probe-delete), never skipped by cm-policy failure. If ctx has a real eventPolicyId (from create), sends a real DELETE. If not, sends literal {eventPolicyId} in path -> 400 or 404. CONFIRMED 2026-06-24: DELETE /event-policies/999 -> 404 ResourceNotFound params[name=resourceType, value=eventPolicyId] — endpoint is structurally reachable.

steps.name: get-metric-perf-data
steps._note: Coverage-only read-shaped POST (metric query). Body CONFIRMED via cascade probing 2026-06-19: requires X-ResourceType header; body wraps metric conditions in metricDataConditions array; queryStartDt/queryEndDt must use ISO 8601 T-suffix format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ); without T-suffix returns 400 backend date-parsing bug. Currently 404 productResourceInfos = products not enrolled in monitoring backend. Blocker: account-prereq. Isolated group so 4xx never affects the event-policy group.

lifecycles._note: Light, READ-ONLY (no writes, no cleanup). Covers all 14 non-mutating cloudmonitoring endpoints. CONFIRMED FACTS 2026-06-20: (1) X-ResourceType header IS required for getaccountproductlist (VM/Object Storage both 200) and getproducteventpolicylist (needs header + productResourceId param). (2) BACKEND BUG: getproducteventlist, getaccounteventlist, geteventpolicyhistories ALL 400 with params[name=resourceType, value=<date>] for ANY date format tried — YYYY-MM-DD, ISO-T-Z, YYYYMMDD, epoch-int. The server-side router reads date param values as 'resourceType' field. X-ResourceType header IS forwarded correctly (debug-traced). No workaround. (3) Event policy IDs are NUMERIC (not UUID) — confirmed via 404 ResourceNotFound probes. (4) addrbook list endpoint is /v1/cloudmonitorings/product/v2/USERS/addrbooks (with 'users/' prefix) — the read_chains auto-derive incorrectly uses /v2/addrbooks (404 path not found) and therefore skips, explaining the smoke test SKIPPED message. (5) CRUD lifecycle engine skip: run_lifecycle() skips ALL lifecycles (including read-only ones) when SCP_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=false — so these steps only run in the CRUD pass. Account: 0 events, 0 event-policies, 0 addrbooks (all products state=NE not enrolled in monitoring backend). Every step is optional with tolerant expect_status including 400.

steps.name: list-events
steps._note: getproducteventlist. CONFIRMED BACKEND BUG 2026-06-20: ANY date value in queryStartDt/queryEndDt (YYYY-MM-DD, ISO-T-Z, compact YYYYMMDD, int-epoch) triggers 400 InvalidInputValue with params[name=resourceType, value=<date>]. This happens regardless of X-ResourceType header presence. The API incorrectly reads date param values as the 'resourceType' field during validation routing. Result is always 400 - this endpoint is unreachable with correct params. Tolerant [200,400,403,404] so group continues. Event ID format is NUMERIC (not UUID - confirmed: 404 ResourceNotFound with numeric id). Without productResourceId: 400 'value: queryStartDt' (missing). Without dates: 400 'Validation failure'. All combinations 400.

steps.name: show-event
steps._note: id-bound read (geteventdetail). Closes GAP-get-id for GET /v1/cloudmonitorings/event/v2/events/{eventId}. Keys off the soft-captured eventId; if list-events found none the {eventId} segment stays literal and normalizes to the catalog '*' key (still records coverage, 4xx's harmlessly). Tolerant [200,400,403,404]; the GET is CALLED so the endpoint is statically reachable.

Soft-captures eventPolicyId to drive the two id-bound policy reads below. Account has 0 event policies (state NE, not enrolled in monitoring backend) so capture is empty and placeholder normalizes to catalog '*'. Tolerant [200,400,403,404].

steps.name: show-event-policy-histories
steps._note: id-bound read (geteventpolicyhistories). CONFIRMED BACKEND BUG 2026-06-20: ALL date formats for queryStartDt/queryEndDt trigger 400 InvalidInputValue params[name=resourceType, value=<date>] — same misparse bug as getproducteventlist/getaccounteventlist. Without dates: 400 Validation failure. So this endpoint is ALWAYS 400 regardless of input. Keys off soft-captured eventPolicyId from list-event-policies-ro (or placeholder '*'). Tolerant [200,400,403,404]; the GET is CALLED so the endpoint is statically reachable.

steps.name: list-addrbooks
steps._note: getadressbooklist. Zero-required-param list (page/size/sort all optional) so this should 200 when the caller has any addrbook. Soft-captures a REAL addrbookId ($.contents[0].addrbookId, AlarmAddrBookDto.addrbookId) to drive show-addrbook-members. If the caller has no addrbook the segment stays a placeholder (normalizes to catalog '*'). Tolerant [200,400,403,404].

Keys off the soft-captured addrbookId from list-addrbooks; placeholder when uncaptured (normalizes to catalog '*'). Tolerant [200,400,403,404]; the GET is CALLED so the endpoint is statically reachable.

steps.name: list-account-products-vm
steps._note: getaccountproductlist. Requires X-ResourceType header (verified live: 'VM' gives 200). Dual-recorded under catalog key because it has params. Soft-captures productResourceId for use in event-policy and event list steps. Empty if account has no VMs (still 200).

steps.name: list-account-products-object-storage
steps._note: getaccountproductlist alternate product type. Object Storage products exist in test account (productResourceId='apitest-logsink' confirmed). Overwrites productResourceId capture if Object Storage has more. Tolerant [200,400,403,404].

steps.name: list-event-policies-with-resource
steps._note: getproducteventpolicylist with real productResourceId from soft-capture. Requires X-ResourceType header AND productResourceId query param (verified live: 200 confirmed). When productResourceId placeholder is un-filled this 400s harmlessly. Dual-recorded under catalog key because it has params. Tolerant [200,400,403,404].

steps.name: list-account-events
steps._note: getaccounteventlist. CONFIRMED BACKEND BUG 2026-06-20: ALL date values for queryStartDt/queryEndDt (YYYY-MM-DD, ISO-T-Z, YYYYMMDD, int-epoch) trigger 400 InvalidInputValue params[name=resourceType, value=<date>]. Header X-ResourceType IS properly forwarded (confirmed by request debug trace). The bug is server-side: the middleware routing reads the queryEndDt value as 'resourceType' validation field. Affects getproducteventlist, getaccounteventlist, and geteventpolicyhistories equally. No client-side workaround exists. Tolerant — 400 counts as reachable endpoint.
